verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-access API (search, extract, crawl, map, research) with SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. A product of this kind could conceivably offer saved or scheduled automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no stored automations or workflows, and no versioning, review or rollback for them. Usage logs, project IDs and session IDs are adjacent tracking features and earn no credit.
